ranked_leads.name: aiXopt
ranked_leads.description: Highly automated, intelligent machines are indispensable for modern production. However, efficient, safe, and high-quality operations depend on precisely configuring numerous parameters. Inadequate settings can have costly consequences: higher scrap rates, lower energy efficiency, reduced throughput, and inconsistent quality. Today, this parameterization is usually carried out through slow, manual adjustment processes that must be repeated every time a product, material, or machine is changed. This is exacerbated by structural changes in the European manufacturing industry: the retirement of experts is reducing the supply of skilled workers, competitive pressure is squeezing margins, and the circular economy requires recycled materials to be processed in a complex manner. These factors make the automation of parameter optimization an urgent, pressing issue for the industry. aiXoptautomates parameter tuning with a “small-data” AI approach that is perfectly tailored to industrial reality. Unlike conventional big-data solutions, the technology requires neither extensive historical data sets nor additional sensors. Instead, the system generates its own data through direct interaction with the machine. At the same time, existing expert knowledge is not discarded; rather, it is flexibly integrated—for example, through physical models or direct feedback. By utilizing intelligent machine models, the software also automatically adapts to product and process changes without the need for time-consuming retraining. The solution is applicable across industries: in laser cladding, it optimizes parameters for maximum productivity; in steel production, it minimizes defects through adjusted casting speeds; and in wind power, it refines operating maps to maximize revenue. This enables aiXopt to deliver a key value proposition for the manufacturing industry: significant improvement in plant performance (productivity, profitability, resource consumption, etc.), increased production flexibility (recycled materials, energy prices, etc.), and mitigation of the impact of the skilled labor shortage.

ranked_leads.name: Athenyx Robotics
ranked_leads.description: Athenyx Robotics is developing an AI-based platform for the scalable implementation and operation of intelligent robotic systems in industry, including humanoid robots. The goal is to transition the current project-driven and highly customized adoption of robotics into a standardized, platform-based approach. In doing so, Athenyx Robotics contributes to Germany’s technological independence and competitiveness while addressing challenges such as the shortage of skilled workers. At its core is a modular Physical AI platform that integrates simulation, perception, and learning methods such as imitation learning and reinforcement learning. This enables robotic skills to be efficiently developed, validated, and reliably transferred to real production environments via Sim2Real approaches. At the same time, the platform enables continuous learning across various use cases, locations, and robot systems.The business model follows a clear scaling logic: In the first phase, specific applications are jointly developed and validated with industry partners. Building on this, pilot deployments are implemented and integrated into production environments. In the third phase, applications are scaled across locations and operated via a standardized platform. Monetization evolves in parallel with the technical maturity of project-based development and integration services, shifting toward recurring revenue through software licensing, platform subscriptions, and continuous model updates. In the long term, this will result in a cross-embodiment physical AI platform that enables the transfer of capabilities, data, and models across different applications and which serves as the central infrastructure for the next generation of industrial automation.
